the program is for 18 months - 3 years, described as being "for the toddler who loves to be on the move" and involving parent participation with a coach through a structured warm-up, games, music, and circuits
.

the Fall Session runs Sept 10 - Dec 16 (no classes Oct 10), with registration beginning February 21
 — so registration for this fall session has already been open since February.
- Price: the centre's page did not post a specific fee for this toddler class in what I could read (a $15 drop-in fee applies to a separate drop-in program, not this session-based class), so I've left price out rather than guess.

I did not find a second real, verifiable parent-and-tot option for this town/window — the Town of Halton Hills recreation pages reference children's dance and camps, but I could not confirm a gymnastics or parent-tot class with an age fit, schedule, or source-confirmed name to add safely.
